articles.summary: Epic renamed Unreal Revision Control (URC) to Lore and released it as an open-source version control system. Here’s how Lore compares to Diversion for Unreal and Unity, large binaries, teams, hosting, workflows, production scale, AI features, and migration from Perforce and Git.
